notes: Not a Railway site: born on dev2 2026-11-02. Primary host webmail.profullstack.com (A -> dev2); webmail.pit.world kept as an alias. Cert by HTTP-01 (both names resolve to dev2). Roundcube webmail, stock image, no repo. Login form has a Server field: users sign in to ANY IMAP server (blank = Forward Email, imap.forwardemail.net). The anyhost plugin (cli-tools dev2/webmail/anyhost, copied to volumes/plugin-anyhost) turns a bare hostname into ssl://host:993, derives SMTP (imap.X -> smtp.X, else the same host; 465 then 587) and refuses private/loopback addresses so the form cannot probe dev2. volumes/config/zz-profullstack.inc.php holds des_key (minted on the box, never committed) and the imap_host override. mail.profullstack.com is NOT this site: it is the bbs box's Mailu MTA (PTR, SPF, cert).
